candidates.implementation: fam_r.CondMeanEP; fixed-lambda conditional-mean e-process; R2-qc and R2-floor25 ablations
candidates.finding: Implementation note gives the target, IPW construction, stopping/freeze rule, and finite-path validity checks. On dev runs R2 promotion was 0/20 on F0 null, 1/20 on Markov rho=.8, 5/20 on rho=.95. Those Markov cases are outside R2's conditional-mean validity class; this is risk characterization, not a validity failure for its stated null. On fresh real streams R2 net costs vary and are not consistently better than D2.
candidates.disposition: Retain only with V1 conditional-mean claim and explicit null/filtration limitations; no general robust-validity claim.

candidates.status: SCREENED; MIXED; SYNTHETIC AND ALL-14-SOURCE REAL FOLLOW-UPS COMPLETE
candidates.implementation: risk-aware economic deployment; R5, R5-nopen, R5-iidvar; risk/economic selector
candidates.finding: Track-R evaluation records selected R5 operating points. At R10: selected alpha .005, risk .087 [0.043,0.170], alt cost 365.8 [359.3,372.2]; R15/R20/R25: alpha .02, risk .138 [0.079,.230], cost 357.5 [350.9,364.1]; R30: alpha .05, risk .212 [.137,.314], cost 353.9 [348.1,359.8]. R5 is a Pareto point at these targets. Fresh-real results vary by dataset; do not infer universal real-data benefit. Some old tables compare against Xu's acquisition-only adapter; those rows are not evidence of superiority to Xu's published method. Post-development frozen-alpha follow-up (100 seeds/regime, alpha .02; seed base 2026110901) found promotions 15/100 on F0_null, 0/100 F0_worse, 26/100 on F5_dep_null_r8 and 24/100 on F5_dep_null_r95. Across six registered alternatives, paired mean net-cost difference R5−D2 was −10.23 [−12.41,−8.05]; however, R5 was more costly than D2 on F1_late_800 (+7.49) and S_dep_better_r95 (+18.69), and did not yield a uniform alternative advantage. This is a new-seed simulator sensitivity at a fixed operating point, not a guarantee or real-data confirmation. All-14-source post-development real-stream replay (20 policy seeds per episode; seed base 2026110903; 14 previously exposed sources, 230 episodes) gives equal-source mean J 404.22 for R5 vs 404.91 D2 (mean source-level contrast -0.68), 412.39 economic_replacement (-8.17), 406.55 CAMS (-2.32), and 414.14 gated adaptive-range (-9.91). The per-source contrast is mixed; no pooled uncertainty is claimed because seeds are policy randomness within fixed episodes and sources/episodes are dependent. This is retrospective cost evidence, not real-world late-transfer, causal utility, or independent confirmation.
candidates.disposition: Mixed: lower average cost than the fixed comparators over the six registered alternatives, but high promotion rates in the tested null regimes and losses on late/strong-persistence alternatives. Do not present the previous selected Track-R frontier as independently validated; the post-development follow-up is one fixed-alpha sensitivity.

candidates.implementation: joint risk/label-budget variants R6:D2-always and R6:D2-floor25
candidates.finding: The joint selector has no chosen point at R5/R10/R15. At R20 it selects baseline D2 (alpha .02; eval risk .1375 [.0785,.2297], cost 372.15); at R25 it selects D2 (alpha .1; risk .2125 [.1371,.3142], cost 361.37); at R30 it selects R6:D2-always (alpha .1; risk .2875 [.1999,.3946], cost 358.17). Thus joint optimization offers no demonstrated advantage over D2 at R20/R25 and is riskier at R30. No direct evidence that reserved budget improves the joint frontier.
candidates.disposition: Do not claim improved joint optimization; report as a negative/limited operating-point result.

candidates.next_action: No advance. If revisited, redesign acquisition jointly with evidence and preregister a feasible operating-point criterion; current grid does not meet R5-R15.

interpretation_limits: All R family summaries are development or simulator-selected evidence, not independent confirmation.
The historical candidate-grid selector and its confidence intervals do not correct for choosing the best configuration on the same development runs.
Xu acquisition-only rows are common-contract adapter comparisons, not the published Xu risk-control method; exclude them from published-certified rankings.
Real stream shifts and utilities are not causal labels; the fresh/twin checks do not establish general validity.
